home.description: AI-powered plant identification and care management. Never miss a watering and keep your plants thriving.
home.heroDescription: Point your camera at any plant to identify it instantly — then let Greeny Corner remind you when to water, feed, and check on it. In English or Arabic.
home.heroNote: Free to start · No account needed to try · Available on iOS & Android
home.statStoresCaption: Free on the App Store & Google Play
home.featuresSubtitle: Four tools, one app — built around how plants actually get cared for, in a real home, not a greenhouse.
home.featureIdDesc: Snap a photo and know exactly what you're growing — species, care needs, and warning signs, instantly.
home.featureTrackerDesc: Keep every plant's watering, feeding, and care schedule in one place, with reminders before they wilt.
home.featureEncyclopediaDesc: Search 400,000+ species by name, each with sourced care guides covering light, water, humidity, and toxicity.
home.featureHealthDesc: Catch disease, pests, and stress early, with treatment steps tailored to what's actually wrong.
home.bilingualDesc: Greeny Corner runs natively in English and Arabic, with the entire interface — layout, navigation, and care schedules — mirrored right-to-left. Not a translation bolted on after the fact. A second first language.
home.downloadDesc: Identify plants and check care schedules from wherever you are. Greeny Corner is available now on the App Store and Google Play.

support.title: Support Center
support.subtitle: We're here to help you get the most out of Greeny Corner
support.faqA1: Simply take a photo of any plant using the app's camera feature. Our AI-powered system will analyze the image and identify the plant species, providing you with detailed care instructions.
support.faqA2: Once you add a plant to your collection, Greeny Corner automatically sets up a watering schedule based on the plant's needs. You'll receive push notifications when it's time to water your plants.
support.faqA3: Yes! We take your privacy seriously. All your data is encrypted and stored securely. We never share your personal information with third parties. Read our Privacy Policy for more details.
support.faqQ4: Can I use the app in Arabic?
support.faqA4: Yes! Greeny Corner fully supports both English and Arabic languages. You can switch between languages in the app settings at any time.
support.faqQ5: How do I delete my account?
support.faqA5: You can delete your account from the Account settings in the app. If you need assistance, please contact us at support@greenycorner.ae and we'll help you with the process.
